prompts.text:
Build a Pomodoro timer web application.

# Main Page

## Main Page UI
- Display the title "pomodoro" using an `h1` tag
- Display the current remaining time (load and use from localStorage, default is 25 minutes)
- Place Start, Stop, and Reset buttons
- Place a Settings button (navigates to the Settings page)

## Main Page Features
- Clicking the Start button starts the timer
- Clicking the Stop button pauses/stops the timer
- Clicking the Reset button resets the timer

# Settings Page

## Settings Page UI
- Place the title "Setting" using an `h3` tag
- Place a single input field to set the timer duration
- Place a Complete Setting (Save) button

## Settings Page Features
- Change timer duration
- Can only be set between 1 minute and 60 minutes (inclusive)
- The Complete Setting button cannot be clicked if the input field is left empty
- The updated time is immediately reflected on the Main Page
- The updated time persists even after a page refresh

# Component Splitting
- Properly split the work into modular components
- Split the components into `Timer`, `Controllers`, and `TimerSettingInput`
- Store the components in the `/components` folder
- If a `src` folder exists, store them in `src/components`
- Must be stored in `/components`, NOT `app/components`

# Miscellaneous
- Do not build or run the Next.js app after completing the development
- Explain the results in English as follows:
- Explain unit by unit for each component (Name, Path, Role)
- Explain in the order of Regular Components -> Page Components
- In the Page Component explanation, include a list of the Regular Components it contains
